So...
Where in the hell do I even start?
Um. Hi.
i'm sorry. i didn't really know how to warn you...
(it's flare, by the way)
Check boolean FlareJumpScare
Are you all right? Seriously?
true
false
She scared the *absolute shit* out of me.
true
It's okay. It's... complicated, I imagine.
true
false
How can I be sure of that?
true
false
no. i very, very much am not
+5 Chemistry
+5 Chemistry
you can't. and i'm sorry for that, too. i don't trust myself to be myself most mornings, either, if that makes you feel better
do you know what its like to wake up every morning, not sure if you're going to be okay?
hah. yeeeaaah. welcome to the club
i... to put it lightly...
or if you're going to even get through the day at all? or will i have to shut myself inside my room, lock the door, and tell everyone to GO AWAY
i wish she were just frightening. i could deal with that. if she were like nailhead, just some horror movie monster come to haunt me
crawl inside of myself and hide myself away to keep them from seeing that side of me
all in black vinyl and chains and nipple piercings and dramatic entrances i could deal with that. but
afraid of what it might do
do you know what it's like... to wake up and not know what version of yourself you're going to be?
Not really.
Yeah. I do.
I can't say that I do, but I can still empathize...
must be nice.
I don't even know if I have a way to describe it. But I understand. Trust me.
Sometimes I wake up and I feel like there's another me living in a stranger's skin. That I don't match what's on the surface. Like I'm a lie.
Some days I wake up and I'm in just such pain I want to crawl into a hole and just wish the day away. Try again tomorrow. But I know it'll always come back.
Update boolean FlarePainEmpathy
Update boolean FlarePainNone
i believe you, drifter. everyone's got their own journey and yours has been long and... unique
now you're singing my song, drifter. i always felt like two people in one body even before lizzie came into my life
chronic pain... when your body betrays you. i had a good friend who had to give up traveling with their band because of it
and... i apologize for how i started our conversations, i was a complete ass. i'm... just absolutely terrified
look... i apologize for how i started our conversations, i was a complete ass. i'm... just absolutely terrified
your pain is your own and i can't pretend to grasp it
learning to love that lie and sing its truth is one of the hardest things i've ever learned to do
No. That's not it.
Yeah. That's it.
i just... first, i lose my band not to the techrot but to that shitbird. and now i have to contend with *her* and her designs on me
Update boolean FlarePainUnique
and it's a lesson i think we never stop struggling with
Update boolean FlarePainChronic
now that my... secret has come out, so to speak, i'd like to start over. hello. i'm flare. and i desperately need your help to get rid of the thing trying to destroy me
Update boolean FlarePainStranger
Can you tell me how this all started? How'd you wind up with Lizzie in the first place?
Why do you think Lizzie is trying to destroy you?
it was after that shitbird had my band members publicly executed
because i can hear her, whispering at the edges of my mind, constantly clawing
on every channel. calling *us* the enemy of the people. how *dare* he?!?!
"you're mine, all of you, you'll always be mine"
how *dare* he try to silence us?! i couldn't let him... i was desperate. i let the anger - the *rage* drive me
"let us in"
i did the only thing i knew how to do. the only thing i've ever known how to do in my life
"we can be one. we can be whole"
i picked up my guitar and i answered his voice with my own
what do *you* think that sounds like, drifter? sounds to me like a demon who wants to eat me
the music that screamed through me and begged to be let loose
Yeah, I don't blame you. I don't think she's... exactly benign, either.
Why not just throw her off a bridge?
Maybe? Or maybe it's just... a symbiotic creature you're fighting against?
it was like nothing i'd ever felt before in my life
+5 Chemistry
oh, thank you, what would i ever do without your sheer unadulterated genius?!?!
symbiotic. you want me to make peace with a thing that talks about wanting to "become one whole" and - and devouring me?!?!
i took to the stage and set free all the pain, all the fury, all the sheer agony i felt from the loss of my friends. i shredded until my fingers bled...
*thank you.* please, we have to try to find a way to get rid of her... permanently
how stupid do you think I am?!?!
you're madder than she is!!
seems like there's a funny thing about infested blood and anything electrical around here...
i don't know how to go on like this otherwise
it was the FIRST thing I tried!!!
this was a mistake. i need to go
Shit.
Oh...

+20 Chemistry
